entries.title: Psalms 8:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm of David.>> O LORD our Lord, how excellent [is] thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 8:2
segments: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger. {ordained: Heb. founded}

entries.title: Psalms 8:3
segments: ¶When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;

entries.title: Psalms 8:4
segments: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?

entries.title: Psalms 8:5
segments: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.

words.text: For thou hast made him a little

entries.title: Psalms 8:6
segments: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all [things] under his feet:

words.text: Thou madest him to have dominion

entries.title: Psalms 8:7
segments: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field; {All...: Heb. Flocks and oxen all of them}

words.text: ; {All...: Heb. Flocks and oxen all of them}

entries.title: Psalms 8:8
segments: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, [and whatsoever] passeth through the paths of the seas.

entries.title: Psalms 8:9
segments: O LORD our Lord, how excellent [is] thy name in all the earth!
